subject: general
question: Which ceremonial folk dance of Puducherry is related to the Hindu epic Ramayana, performed at the Villianur temple in Puducherry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Garadi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Garadi:
 
• This dance has a mythological origin.
 
• When Rama defeated Ravana, the vanars danced to celebrate his victory.
 
• It is performed during all festivals of the region.
 
• It lasts for five to eight hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hulivesha:**
 
• Hulivesha is a dance form of Karnataka.
 
• It is performed to pay tribute to Goddess Durga.
 
• Hulivesha performance often involves a group of people dressing up in tiger costumes.
 
• **Dalkhai:**
 
• The Dalkhai dance of Odisha is usually performed to please Goddess Durga.
 
• The dance Dalkai originates from the Sambalpur district of Odisha.
 
• The main theme of this dance form is Radha and Krishna.
 
• **​Tippani:**
 
• Tippani is a folk dance style originating from the Saurashtra Chorwad area of Gujarat, India.
 
• The dance was only done by women. 
 
• The main musical instruments used for music are Zanz, Manjira, Tabla, Dhol, and Shehnai.
